test.description:
This test verifies updating Number custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Number custom field values
* Updating positive and negative numeric values
* Updating decimal and whole number values
* Validation of invalid non-numeric input
* Validation of Number custom field stepper controls behavior
* Correct inline editing behavior across supported views

Test: TC-6148 — SPM - OKR - Updating Number custom field values across OKR views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating Number custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Number custom field values
* Updating positive and negative numeric values
* Updating decimal and whole number values
* Validation of invalid non-numeric input
* Validation of Number custom field stepper controls behavior
* Correct inline editing behavior across supported views

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* Number custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for Number fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6148 SPM - OKR - Updating Number custom field values across OKR views
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to Number field
   Expected: Number custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "100"
* Objective - "25.5"
* Key Result - "0"
4. Navigate to the Key result Number custom field and update the value
   Data: newValue: abc
   Expected: Value is not saved. Non-numeric characters are not accepted in the Number custom field input
5. Update value
   Data: newValue: 250
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
6. Click on field value and use field stepper controls to change value
   Data: newValue: 253

!xray-attachment://8271eb35-1952-4806-9040-53512558870f|width=353,height=134!
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly when using the stepper controls
7. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Number field is visible with correct value.
8. Navigate to the Number field and update the value
   Data: newValue: -15
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
9. Open Key-result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Number field is visible with correct value.
10. Navigate to the Number field and update the value
   Data: newValue: 999.99
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
